title: Father, in Thy Presence Now
description: Father, in Thy Presence Now in Tonic Solfa to VIENNA, doh is G: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 5 verses and a piano.
about: These words were printed without an author's name in A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion, compiled by Samuel Longfellow and Samuel Johnson (Boston, 1848), as hymn 381, “Marriage Hymn”.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Sevens (7.7.7.7) (7.7.7.7), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to VIENNA; any other Sevens (7.7.7.7) tune fits them as well.
underlay: Fa-ther, in Thy pre-sence now Has been pledged the nu-ptial vow; Heart to heart, as hand in hand, Linked in one Thy child-ren stand.

lines: Father, in Thy presence now
Has been pledged the nuptial vow;
Heart to heart, as hand in hand,
Linked in one Thy children stand.
God of love! this union bless,
Not with earth's low happiness;
But with joys whose heavenly spring
Shall diviner raptures bring.
May these blended souls be found
Firm in duty's active round;
Daily every burden share,
Nightly seek Thy shadowing care.
When against their trembling forms
Shoot the arrows of life's storms;
Or when age and sickness wait
Heralds at life's parting gate; —
In the fulness of belief,
May they look beyond the grief;
And together fearless tread
In the path where Thou shall lead.

source: A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion (1848)
licence: Public domain: anonymous words in print by 1848.
credits: Words anonymous, public domain, as printed in A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion (1848); set to VIENNA by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
